flagged.title: Context: 1950s Salford & Kitchen Sink Drama
flagged.reason: The video incorrectly defines Eduqas AO4 as assessing context and claims context earns top AO4 marks, directly contradicting the lesson which clarifies that AO4 assesses technical accuracy and the drama question awards no marks for context.

mark_affecting.video_says: Eduqas AO4: Show understanding of the relationship between the text and its contexts. This objective strictly requires you to explicitly connect the text to the context in which it was written.
mark_affecting.lesson_says: The drama question gives no marks for context. It assesses AO1 (understanding and personal response), AO2 (language, form and structure), and AO4 , which rewards accurate, well-controlled writing of your own. Context can still help you explain a moment in the play. It just earns no marks by itself...

flagged.title: Act 1 Scene 1: Jo, Helen & Peter
flagged.reason: The video invents a non-existent opening line for Jo ('The roof's leaking') and attributes a non-existent description to the stage directions for Peter ('loud check suit'), both of which would directly cost marks in an Eduqas literature exam.

mark_affecting.quote: And what's Jo's very first line? 'The roof's leaking.' It's just brilliantly simple. That blunt opening line immediately establishes the squalor...
The stage directions describe him perfectly... He wears a loud check suit, drives a flashy car

flagged.title: Act 1 Scene 2: Jo & the Boy
flagged.reason: The video teaches two completely fabricated quotations ('How can you marry me? You're only a sailor' and 'Do you think I'm really beautiful?') as textual evidence, and tells students a quote from another scene is a 'must-learn' quote for this scene.

mark_affecting.quote: How can you marry me? You're only a sailor.
Which brings us to an absolutely must-learn quote for your exam. Jo says, 'I really do live at the same time as myself, don't I?'

flagged.title: Staging, Structure & Social Realism
flagged.reason: The video asserts that the entire play takes place in just one room, which is factually incorrect and causes students to be marked wrong on knowledge check 3 of this lesson.

mark_affecting.quote: the entire play takes place in just one room.
